learning_outcomes.text: Apply the acquired knowledge to identify, formulate and solve problems in broad contexts, being able to integrate them by working in multidisciplinary teams.
Understand the impact of engineering on the environment, the sustainable development of society and the importance of working in a professional and responsible environment.
Possess learning skills that allow continued lifelong learning for adequate professional development.
Incorporate ICT and Industrial Engineering technologies and tools into their professional activities.
Know and apply the knowledge of basic sciences and technologies to the practice of Industrial Engineering.

assessment_rules: All tests are graded out of 10. Passing the course requires attendance and submission of cooperative action work; these grades are the geometric mean of three scores, carried over, but can be improved. For progressive evaluation, the final grade is the higher of (20% cooperative actions + 30% partial exam + 50% final exam) or the global evaluation grade, requiring a minimum of 3 in the final exam and capping the final grade at 4.9 if minimums are not met. For global and extraordinary evaluations, the final grade is the higher of (20% cooperative actions + 80% final exam), with a minimum of 3 in the final exam needed to achieve an overall grade of 5.
